name: Multi Theft Auto: San Andreas
description: The Lua-scriptable GTA: San Andreas multiplayer mod. Official server tarball downloaded from multitheftauto.com (always the latest stable).

install.command: cp -r multitheftauto_linux_x64/* . && rm -rf multitheftauto_linux_x64 && chmod +x mta-server64

mkdir -p mods/deathmatch/resources && if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq mtasa-resources.zip -d mods/deathmatch/resources && rm mtasa-resources.zip; else echo 'NOTE: unzip not found — extract mtasa-resources.zip into mods/deathmatch/resources manually'; fi

install.content:
<config>
    <servername>{{HOSTNAME}}</servername>
    <serverip>auto</serverip>
    <serverport>{{SERVER_PORT}}</serverport>
    <maxplayers>{{MAX_PLAYERS}}</maxplayers>
    <password></password>
    <httpserver>1</httpserver>
    <httpport>{{HTTP_PORT}}</httpport>
    <httpdownloadurl></httpdownloadurl>
    <httpmaxconnectionsperclient>5</httpmaxconnectionsperclient>
    <ase>1</ase>
    <donotbroadcastlan>0</donotbroadcastlan>
    <bandwidth_reduction>medium</bandwidth_reduction>
    <voice>0</voice>
    <resource src="admin" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="defaultstats" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="helpmanager" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="joinquit" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="mapcycler" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="mapmanager" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="parachute" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="play" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="resourcebrowser" startup="1" protected="1" default="true" />
    <resource src="resourcemanager" startup="1" protected="1" />
    <resource src="scoreboard" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="spawnmanager" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="votemanager" startup="1" protected="0" />
    <resource src="webadmin" startup="1" protected="0" />
</config>

<acl>
    <acl name="Default">
        <right name="general.ModifyOtherObjects" access="false"></right>
        <right name="general.http" access="false"></right>
    </acl>
    <acl name="Moderator">
        <right name="general.ModifyOtherObjects" access="false"></right>
        <right name="function.kickPlayer" access="true"></right>
        <right name="function.setPlayerMuted" access="true"></right>
    </acl>
    <acl name="Admin">
        <right name="general.ModifyOtherObjects" access="true"></right>
        <right name="general.http" access="true"></right>
        <right name="general.adminpanel" access="true"></right>
        <right name="command.start" access="true"></right>
        <right name="command.stop" access="true"></right>
        <right name="command.restart" access="true"></right>
        <right name="command.refresh" access="true"></right>
        <right name="command.shutdown" access="true"></right>
        <right name="function.kickPlayer" access="true"></right>
        <right name="function.banPlayer" access="true"></right>
        <right name="function.setServerPassword" access="true"></right>
    </acl>
    <group name="Everyone">
        <acl name="Default"></acl>
        <object name="user.*"></object>
        <object name="resource.*"></object>
    </group>
    <group name="Moderator">
        <acl name="Moderator"></acl>
    </group>
    <group name="Admin">
        <acl name="Moderator"></acl>
        <acl name="Admin"></acl>
        <object name="resource.admin"></object>
        <object name="resource.webadmin"></object>
    </group>
</acl>

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Avoid the characters & < > (written into an XML config).

variables.label: HTTP port (TCP)
variables.description: Serves resource downloads to joining players.

variables.label: ASE query port (UDP)
variables.description: Always game port + 123 (default 22126); used by the ASE server list.

readyRegex: Server started and is ready to accept connections
notes: The Linux tarball ships without mtaserver.conf/acl.xml — the install writes working ones (edit them freely; re-running install overwrites them). The default resources (gamemode 'play', admin panel, etc.) are fetched as a zip and need the host's unzip binary — if it is missing, extract mtasa-resources.zip into mods/deathmatch/resources via the file manager. Create an admin account in the server console with: addaccount <name> <password>, then map it to the Admin group in acl.xml. The console command 'shutdown' stops the server gracefully.
